_: Example .mcp.json for chef Claude Code sessions. Drop this in the repo root (the same checkout the operator works in — chef has no separate worktree, see workflow.md) or merge into the existing one. For local dev, admin-svc auto-defaults Bpm:Chef:Token to 'dev-chef-token' when ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT=Development and no token is configured, so the literal Bearer value below works without exporting anything. For production, set the same token under Bpm:Chef:Token in admin-svc appsettings and update the header here.
